summary: CAIR Action, which assesses candidates on civil rights and foreign policy including Gaza and ceasefire positions, designated incumbent Rudy J. Rodriguez as preferred for the Franklin-McKinley at-large school board seat in the 2026 general. Preferred is a recommendation tier below full endorsement, signaling a favorable but not top-tier assessment of Rodriguez's stance on Palestinian justice.
